items.description: Free, offline AI subtitle generator: Whisper writes .srt/.vtt subtitles or burns captions into your video. Runs on your own PC (NVIDIA GPU optional), no uploads, no per-minute fees.

items.name: ai-video-subtitle-generator
items.description: AI-powered video subtitle generator built with Python, Whisper, Gemma, FFmpeg, and FastAPI. Automatically transcribes videos, enhances captions with a local LLM, generates SRT subtitles, and renders the final subtitled video through a simple web interface.

items.name: hinglish_subtitle_generator
items.description: FastAPI backend that converts uploaded videos into burned-in subtitles. It extracts audio with FFmpeg, transcribes Hindi speech using Whisper, cleans text into Hinglish via Gemini, segments captions, creates ASS subtitle files, and renders output.mp4 through step-by-step APIs or one-shot /run/{job_id}.

items.name: AI-video-caption-generator
items.description: AI-Powered Video Caption Generator is a Streamlit-based web application that automatically generates subtitles for videos using OpenAI Whisper. It extracts audio, transcribes speech with high accuracy, generates SRT subtitle files, and embeds captions directly into videos using FFmpeg — delivering fast, automated, and accessible video captioning.

items.name: videocaption_generator
items.description: Automatic subtitle generator using Python, Whisper ASR, FFmpeg, and MoviePy. Extracts audio, transcribes speech (English/Hindi), creates SRT files, and burns styled captions into video.

items.name: obs-whisper-subtitles
items.description: Automatic SRT subtitles generator for videos recorded with OBS, powered by Whisper (GPU).  Optimized for:  Short, readable subtitles  Fast clip editing workflows  Fully local processing (no cloud uploads)  Includes a custom subtitle formatter that splits captions into lines with a maximum of 12 characters, improving readability and timing accuracy.

items.name: SuperSubtitler
